mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.name, u.phone, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.email, u.major, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, u.created_at AS joinedAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.is_deleted AS isDeleted, u.ban_status AS banStatus, u.banned_until AS bannedUntil, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l WHERE l.user_id = u.user_id) AS likeGivenCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = l.post_id WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id) AS likeReceivedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) AS deviceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_mutes m WHERE m.user_id = u.user_id) AS muteCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pl.points), 0) FROM penalty_log pl WHERE pl.user_id = u.user_id AND pl.voided_at IS NULL AND pl.expires_at > NOW()) AS cautionPoints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_log w WHERE w.user_id = u.user_id AND w.expires_at > NOW()) AS warningCount, (SELECT bl.starts_at FROM ban_log bl WHERE bl.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastBanStartAt, (SELECT bl.ends_at FROM ban_log bl WHERE bl.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastBanEndAt, (SELECT MAX(s.access_hour) FROM stats_access_hourly s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id) AS lastAccessAt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(s.access_hour)) FROM stats_access_hourly s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.access_hour >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)) AS accessDays30, (SELECT MAX(a.last_launched_at) FROM app_launch_daily a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id) AS lastAppLaunchAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_launch_daily a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.launch_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)) AS appLaunchDays30 FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT google_email AS googleEmail, linked_at AS linkedAt, last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt FROM user_google_calendar WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(access_hour) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM stats_access_hourly WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND access_hour >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(access_hour) ORDER BY date
SELECT launch_date AS date, launch_count AS count FROM app_launch_daily WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND launch_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) ORDER BY launch_date
